description: Electricity demand Rome is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Bianchi Filippo Maria. The data represent the electricity consumption coming from a backbone of the energy supply network in the city of Rome. The time series is sampled every 10 minutes. The datatset has been originally presented in Bianchi, Filippo Maria, et al. "Short-term electric load forecasting using echo state networks and PCA decomposition." Ieee Access 3 (2015). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
